lens: Meta — zoomed-out fit with master plan / M01-P18 arc / sprawl trajectory
answer: PR #12 fits the master-plan trajectory in intent: it tightens repo hygiene (gitignore .audit/, .config/) and collapses a parallel infra root (deploy/gitops/) into the established infra/kyverno/ root used by the M01-P18 agentic VCS pipeline. Both moves directly serve [[feedback_governance_pipeline_canonical]] (single Foundry pipeline arc, no parallel gitops root) and [[deprecate-external-agent-coord-tooling]] (.audit/ is agent-coord scratch output). ADR-0117 documents both decisions in one paragraph each, which matches the v2.2.0 lightweight CC-2 governance bar. Net topology effect: -1 root directory, -1 tracked transient artifact stream, +1 ADR; debt and sprawl both go DOWN. However, the PR's existence itself is evidence of an upstream gap — .audit/agent-read.jsonl slipped into the tree because no PreCommit/CI lane rejects writes from retired agent-coord tooling. A repo-hygiene gate (forbidden-paths CI check) would prevent re-occurrence and is the missing piece that keeps this PR from being a one-shot. Additionally, working-tree inspection shows deploy/gitops/oya-vcs-admission/ and .audit/agent-read.jsonl STILL present locally and ADR-0116/0117 files NOT on disk — needs confirmation this is just an unsynced workspace vs. a real merge defect.
key_claims: Direction is correct: consolidating into infra/kyverno/ reduces sprawl per P9 and aligns with M01-P18 single-pipeline arc.
.audit/ untracking aligns with [[deprecate-external-agent-coord-tooling]] (2026-05-16) — these are oya-tooling-agent-read outputs from sunset-bound tooling.
ADR-0117 right-sizes governance for CC-2 (one paragraph per decision, no over-process).
PR is a hygiene patch, not a masterplan-arc change — neither advances nor blocks M01-P18 substrate; correctly scoped to CC-2.
Missing systemic fix: no CI lane forbids .audit/, .config/, or deploy/gitops/ paths reappearing — this PR will be re-needed without a gate.
uncertainty_areas: Local working tree still shows deploy/gitops/oya-vcs-admission/ and .audit/agent-read.jsonl; ADR-0116 and ADR-0117 files not on disk under docs/decisions/. Cannot confirm from inspection whether merge actually landed on dev tip or if this is purely a stale local workspace on a different branch.
ADR-0116 referenced in task prompt but not produced by this PR — unclear whether ADR-0116 is a separate companion ADR or a typo for ADR-0117.
bominal/ lane-retirement explicitly deferred — fit with the broader sunset arc depends on that follow-up PR landing.

findings.summary: No CI gate prevents .audit/, .config/, or retired deploy/gitops/ paths from reappearing — this PR fixes the symptom, not the upstream lane gap.
findings.recommended_action: Add a forbidden-paths lane (e.g. lean-repo-hygiene) that fails CI on any tracked file under .audit/, .config/nextest.toml, or deploy/gitops/. Cite [[deprecate-external-agent-coord-tooling]] as the policy source.

findings.summary: ADR-0117 should cross-link the retirement-policy ADR-0108 (sunset-lifecycle-automation) and the deprecation memory note to make the zoomed-out trajectory legible from the ADR alone.
findings.recommended_action: Edit ADR-0117 to add a See-also section pointing to ADR-0108 and the deprecate-external-agent-coord-tooling memory entry.
